title: US stocks rebound as oil prices ease, inflation data steadies market sentiment
text: US stocks rebound as oil prices ease, inflation data steadies market sentiment. As of 1:49 p.m. Eastern Time, the S&P 500 climbed 1.1%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 1.1%, and the Nasdaq Composite was 1.2% higher.
